data.one_liner: Build local, on-device RAG in Flutter with semantic search and hybrid retrieval.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart package to ingest documents, chunk them, embed them on-device using ONNX, and run hybrid vector (HNSW) and keyword (BM25) search. Works completely offline with local storage and integrates with any LLM.
use_when: You need offline, on-device document search and retrieval for a Flutter app.
User data must stay on the device for privacy and zero server cost.
You want to combine vector search and keyword retrieval before feeding context to an LLM.
avoid_when: You require cloud-hosted vector databases or server-side document processing.
You need built-in OCR for scanned, image-only PDFs without external setup.
strengths: Completely offline and private operation with local embedding and SQLite storage.
Hybrid retrieval combining HNSW vector search and BM25 keyword search via RRF fusion.
Compatible with any custom LLM generation function or backend.
weaknesses: Requires manual platform configuration and downloading model packs for native dependencies.
Scanned or image-only PDFs require an external OCR layer.
Model assets must be bundled and initialized correctly.
data.setup_notes: Requires running a Dart setup script for model presets, adjusting native iOS/macOS host deployment targets, and adding model assets to pubspec.yaml.
